visual_rebuild.new_model_strategy: rigid modular meshes parented to existing animated bones
features: large lime leaves with raised vein pieces
back water tank with transparent glass and antenna
articulated cream arms with green joints and hands
green watering nozzle and clear curved hose
short legs with green ankle joints and chunky cream boots
dark mechanical panel seam and body latches

water_animation.behavior: Each droplet scales in, falls from the nozzle through a gravity-like path, then scales out before clip end.

limitations: Direct GLB patch was validated structurally, but Blender and Godot executables were unavailable for headed visual validation.
The model uses rigid modular pieces parented to the existing skeleton; Human review should check clipping in all 15 clips.
Godot may choose to replace embedded animated droplets with GPUParticles3D later, but the GLB already contains visible animated droplet nodes for the water clip.
